questions.stem_text:
A major difference between programmed and unprogrammed theories of senescence is that
programmed theories

options.A: Attribute senescence only to environmental factors
options.B: Are far too difficulty to test
options.C: Claim that senescence follows a predetermined plan
options.D: Rely too heavily on computer models

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Claim that senescence follows a predetermined plan

options.A: Determining what first causes the senescence in the immune system
options.B: Auto-immune disorders are far too rare
options.C: That the immune system does not decline with age

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Determining what first causes the senescence in the immune system
